newsitem.title: SYRIA: Syria sells 55,000 tonnes wheat at $194/tonne.
newsitem.headline: Syria sells 55,000 tonnes wheat at $194/tonne.

text.p: Syria has sold 55,000 tonnes of hard amber durum wheat at $194 per tonne fob, a spokesman for Syria's General Establishment for Cereal Processing and Trade (GECPT) said on Saturday.
He told Reuters the wheat was sold to several companies and would be delivered during January. He did not reveal the names of the companies.
He also did not also say whether the wheat sold related to a previous tender issued by the GECPT in November for 100,000 tonnes.
